Package aor.proj3t.service.impl

Class ExportServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.service.impl.BaseService
aor.proj3t.service.impl.ExportServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
ExportService
@ApplicationScoped public class ExportServiceImpl extends BaseService implements ExportService
Implementation of the ExportService interface. This comprehensive service provides data export functionality in multiple formats including CSV and PDF, supporting various data types such as users, evaluations, and trainings.

Key functionalities include:

  • User data export with filtering capabilities
  • Evaluation data export with comprehensive details
  • Training data export and reporting
  • CSV format export using OpenCSV library
  • PDF format export using iText library
  • Customizable data filtering and selection
  • Professional document formatting and styling

This service provides essential reporting and data analysis capabilities, enabling administrators and managers to extract and analyze system data in standardized formats for further processing or archival purposes.
